name: Hananomiya Mizuho
source:
Hometown: Kyoto, Japan

[url=/c9482]Luna[/url]'s friend and a kind Yamato Nadeshiko who cares greatly for her friends, and especially Asahi whom she is highly fond of.

Due to her lack of interactions with men and her childhood experiences with bullies, she is very afraid of men.
